searchText: Sorry, it's two weeks later, but here's a write-up I wrote a couple months ago on what has been written on ASE: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/thoughts-on-address-space-extension-ase/6779 from the top of my head, and skimming my post: - using bridge contracts to let 32bytes addresses interact with 20bytes contract is very clean, but forces users/dev to deploy bridge contracts for every 20bytes contract they want to interact with - translation maps + edict works well enough but the translation map is possibly voluminous, and there might be issues around state expiry of the map and/or the account state
